mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) may potentiate empagliflozin's effects on blood pressure and glucose metabolism, with increased risk of hypotension and serotonin-related complications if empagliflozin is combined with serotonergic agents; additionally, MAOI dietary restrictions and drug interactions require careful monitoring.
action: Monitor blood pressure, blood glucose, and renal function closely; assess necessity of concurrent use; educate patient on MAOI dietary restrictions; consider alternative antidiabetic agents with lower interaction potential.
